title: Non-vacuity (G11V), D2 zero-blob check, checker pin and upgrade procedure

predictions.claim: L_undo_CSR and L_undo_BD get non-degenerate inhabitants (the two state binders differ), found by the compiled model's search with the claim replaced by s1 == s2.

L_disch_stale and L_disch_stale_commit get reachable inhabitants: the state binder is run(p, s0) for a trace p that opens a challenge and lets it go stale (kappa true), with a permitted / proof-backed action.

Each of the 5 premised PROVED M0 laws is inhabited by the header that carries its pin bytes and zeros in every other field; the 2 premised REFUTED M0 laws and the 4 premised REFUTED M1 laws are counted through their accepted counter-law witnesses (status counter_witness).
A law with contradictory premises (is_commitBatch(a) and is_wait(a)) gets non_vacuity status unknown with its search bound, so G11V would fail for it.

regressions.claim: D2: 0x01 || sha256(0xc0 || 0^47)[1:] equals ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH (Rollup.sol:25) and EmptyVersionedHash (common/blob/payload.go:22). Already recomputed by hand in I1 (docs/M1_REPORT.md §5), so not a prediction.
Every proof file checks well within a 120 s budget (record timings are all under a few seconds); a checker-upgrade dry run to the current fingerprint shows zero record diffs (G1 determinism).
All 24 statuses, statement hashes and generated .bend files outside nonvac/ unchanged; gates M0 and M1 pass, now with G11V.
